name: Tofu Skewers with Jalapeño Blueberry Sauce & Feta-Pecan Mixed Greens

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: If using wooden skewers, place 8-10 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.

Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ jalapeño peppers
3 (6 oz) pkgs blueberries
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Quarter jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Mince and place in a medium saucepan. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Add blueberries to the pan with the jalapeño along with maple syrup, vinegar, ketchup, soy sauce, and salt. Stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp pure maple syrup
3 tbsp apple cider vinegar
3 tbsp ketchup
1 ½ tsp soy sauce
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Set pan over high heat and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until saucy and thickened, 8-10 minutes. Remove from heat and allow to cool slightly.
Meanwhile, large dice tofu. Place in a large bowl along with oil and spices; stir to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp paprika
2 ½ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Thread tofu onto skewers and place on a plate. Alternatively, you can cook the tofu pieces directly on the grill pan without using skewers. (Reserve bowl for the salad.)
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor skillet, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the pan is hot, working in batches if necessary, add the skewers and grill, turning occasionally, until tofu is lightly charred and warmed through, about 8 minutes. Return to the plate.
Meanwhile, peel and mince shallots. Place in the reserved bowl along with oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper; stir to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ shallots
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place corn in the colander and rinse under hot water (from the tap) to defrost. Add to the bowl with dressing.
Roughly chop pecans. Add to the bowl along with mixed greens and feta. Gently toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup pecan halves
1 ½ (4 oz) pkgs crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide skewers and salad between plates. Top skewers with sauce and enjoy!
